market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: A participant filtering saved notes cannot see how many local meetings remain visible or reset a non-empty result set in one action.
market.revenueHypothesis: Clear local result counts and an in-context reset make a growing meeting library easier to trust and reuse without adding external search infrastructure.

increment.name: library-filter-status
acceptanceCriteria: A non-empty library shows its local meeting count below the search controls.
Active search or Open actions filtering shows Showing X of Y local meetings with correct singular and plural copy.
When active filters still return meetings, a Clear filters button appears beside the existing controls.
When active filters return zero meetings, the existing empty-state Clear filters action remains the sole reset control.
The increment introduces no CSS, dependency, external search, account, provider, storage, or billing change.
The focused contracts, TypeScript, and production build pass locally.
LICENSE, dependency manifests, credentials, providers, billing, and deployment configuration remain unchanged.

delivery.checker: Codex separate local verification; independent checker unavailable in this single-agent slice
delivery.rollback: Revert only the library filter status commit on feat/sidenote-meeting-goal.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one verified library/search increment; do not merge, deploy, submit to an app store, spend, change credentials, or change licensing.
